shots.name: yard-approach
shots.caption: The approach from the Nightcell muster point, looking north up the centre lane toward the false dawn.

shots.name: west-catwalk
shots.caption: The west catwalk above the pipe rack — one of the yard's two vertical routes, and the only place both spawn markers are visible at once.

shots.name: tank-row
shots.caption: The east lane, running between the storage tanks and the perimeter with the gantry deck overhead.

shots.name: central-hardpoint
shots.caption: Pushing north off the central hard point. Container colour encodes the contested axis — cyan is Directorate ground — so the lane is legible without a minimap.

shots.name: gantry-overlook
shots.caption: From the east gantry, looking back across the container yard under the sodium masts.

shots.name: north-gate
shots.caption: The Directorate end of the yard, looking into the first light beyond the north wall.

shots.name: pipe-rack-run
shots.caption: The west lane pipe rack, looking south under the catwalk. Cover here is continuous but low, so the lane rewards movement over holding an angle.

shots.name: container-alley
shots.caption: Between the northern container stacks. The corrugation and corner castings are the only cover in the centre lane, and both sides can reach it in the opening seconds.

shots.name: muster-point
shots.caption: The Nightcell muster point at the southern gate, where a squad forms up before pushing into the yard.

shots.name: under-the-gantry
shots.caption: Beneath the east gantry, looking up the tank row. Holding the deck overhead means giving up the lane below it.
